description:
The Quartermaster hands you a purse heavy enough to be a point, and a list of parts the Watch can't make and won't do without.

All of it's sold on Halcyon Boulevard. So is everything else. The clinic on that same street will fit you anything you like while you wait, at a discount, to anybody who looks like they might be considering it, and they're extremely good at spotting who's considering it.

She doesn't tell you not to. She has never told anybody not to, in twenty years of handing out that purse.

She says: bring the parts back, and bring yourself back. Then she watches you the whole way to the door.

fail_on.desc: You had something fitted. The parts are on the counter and so is the receipt, and the Quartermaster reads the second one first.
You came back a different shape. The Watch have a word for that and it isn't one they say to your face.

name: Nothing Bought

objectives.desc: Work the length of Halcyon Boulevard for the parts on the list.
emotes: {who} works down the list, counter by counter, and is offered something better at every one of them.
{who} is called by their first name by a man they have never met, who read it off a screen.
{who} finds the fourth item is stocked by nobody on the Boulevard, and buys it in an alley off it.

objectives.desc: The last part is behind the clinic counter. Wait for it.
emotes: {who} sits in a warm, clean waiting room while somebody explains what could be done about the ache in their hands.
{who} is handed a brochure, and holds it, and doesn't read it.
{who} is told there's no obligation, twice, by two different people.
{who} is quoted a figure, and the figure is less than what's in the purse.

objectives.desc: The surgeon has time while you wait, and would like to use it.
emotes: {who} is asked, pleasantly, what they do with their hands all day.
{who} is talked out of the expensive one by the man who would have been paid for it.
{who} is quoted a price, and then a smaller price, and isn't pushed on either.
{who} is told the offer stands, and that it isn't the kind that expires.

objectives.desc: Take the parts back to the Quartermaster.
emotes: {who} puts the parts and what's left of the purse on the counter, in that order.
{who} notices her counting the purse second.
